name: powerLeverAngle
description: Throttle (power lever angle), 0 - 100. 50 is MIL (max dry) thrust; 100 is MAX (burner)

name: milPwr
description: Power lever angle for military power - above this, we get afterburners

name: idleThrust
description: Idle thrust at current flight conditions with power at 0. Output of function table.

name: militaryThrust
description: Max dry thrust at current flight conditions with power at 50. Output of function table.

name: maxThrust
description: Max augmented thrust at current flight conditions with power at 100. Output of function table.

name: thrustBodyForce_X
description: Net steady-state thrust of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, in the body X axis. If PWR below MIL_PWR, interpolate between T_IDLE and T_MIL. If PWR is above MIL_PWR, interpolate between T_MAX and T_MIL.

name: thrustBodyForce_Y
description: Net steady-state thrust of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, in the body Y axis

name: thrustBodyForce_Z
description: Net steady-state thrust of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, in the body Z axis

name: thrustBodyMoment_Roll
description: Net steady-state moment of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, about the body X axis

name: thrustBodyMoment_Pitch
description: Net steady-state moment of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, about the body Y axis

name: thrustBodyMoment_Yaw
description: Net steady-state moment of the engine for given flight conditions, power lever angle, about the body Z axis
